paper_title: Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism

model_annotation: The donut chart, titled “Stimuli Type,” illustrates the distribution of different types of stimuli used in a study related to generative AI in journalism, as part of “Agency A” in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is divided into nine color-coded segments, each labeled with a stimulus category and its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is “Draft/Other” at 28.5% (dark red), followed by “Press Release” at 21.9% (golden yellow), and “External News Article” at 13.1% (dark green). “Interview” accounts for 10.2% (dark blue), while “Organizational Report” and “Event Posting” each represent 8.8% (light purple and medium purple, respectively). “Organizational Website” comprises 6.6% (light blue), “Social Media Post” 1.5% (light green), and “Intra-agency news article” the smallest portion at 0.7% (orange). Percentages are displayed next to each label, and the segments appear to be ordered roughly by size in clockwise fashion starting from the top right. The chart has no legend, as labels are directly connected to their respective slices.
